Meet the unofficial CEO

It started with a dog.
Specifically, Alfie.

Alfie is a rescue dog. These days he has a family, a yard, a couch, and a deeply questionable belief that every package delivered to the house is obviously for him.

We wanted to help more animals get that same second chance. So we made coffee.

Alfie's takeThings Alfie knows about coffee: absolutely nothing. He is, however, very good at quality control.

Questions

Before you blame Alfie.

Where does the $5 go? +
$5 from each bag is credited to the animal rescue you choose. If you are ordering through a participating rescue's link, the purchase is associated with that organization.
Can I support a cat rescue? +
Yes. Rally Roasters is built around animal rescue, not just dogs. Participating organizations can support dogs, cats, or other animals in need.
Do rescues have to buy coffee upfront? +
No. Rescues do not purchase or hold inventory. Rally Roasters handles the coffee and ships directly to supporters.
How is the coffee shipped? +
Rescue Blend is roasted, packed, and shipped directly to the customer.
Is this a fundraiser only? +
No. A rescue can share its Rally Roasters link year-round. There is no required campaign window or fundraising season.
ALFIE SAYS YOU'RE GOING TO BUY COFFEE ANYWAY.

Might as well make it count.

Good coffee for your morning. $5 for the animal rescue you choose. Everybody wins.
